svg.title: Comfy Colab Kit: request path, 10-state lifecycle, and auto-stop gates

g.text: An always-available, wake-on-demand ComfyUI on Google Colab
Zero-GPU idle · single shared instance · automatic shutdown

svg.text: From “press Wake” to “GPU released”: request path, 10-state lifecycle, five shutdown gates

g.text: Agents and browsers travel the very same gateway path
10-state lifecycle · dashed lines are failure fallbacks
any boot state fails → failed → retry allocating
stop is allowed from any non-sleeping state → VM released
BILLING_STATES · five boot states + ready + switching + failed — a Colab instance exists here and is billed at 1.71 CU/h
Five gates · any one of them releases the GPU and its CU
skipped while the queue is busy
A second wake joins the boot already in flight.
A restart re-attaches and replays progress.
The Colab token stays here and travels over stdin.
